seed: Assume positions live on a lattice. Infer the step size and bounds from the data and write movement as lattice moves with explicit bound and obstacle checks.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) move on a 6-cell lattice: A1/A2 shift ring+beam by -/+6 rows, carrying on-beam blocks and pushing hit ones; a move is cancelled if anything leaves the play rect (the colour-4 bbox above the HUD row).
A4/A3 grow/shrink the beam by 6 within [1, play_right]. The hooked next/collected block (x == tip-4) drags on-beam blocks; otherwise extension pushes blocks in the swept columns.
Tags: hooking next with only collected blocks on the beam -> collected, then the rightmost todo becomes next. A collected block off the beam reverts and becomes next.
HUD: the row-53 bar fills from the right on every 3rd non-click action. The count is hidden state, continuity-gated, with a fallback from the bar length. A collected block's legend icon gets a 0 centre.
Open: the bar phase cannot be read from the frame alone, so stateless calls fall back to an estimate.
